d:
Don’t wait until life forces you to slow down. How often do we push until the body, the mind, a relationship or life itself says „enough” before we change something.
But the subtle signs usually come much earlier. Rest before you’re exhausted. Make time before you’re running out of it. Take care of what matters before something forces you to.
My music is made for exactly this. To give you a moment to slow down, breathe, align and come back to yourself.
You don’t need a crisis to make space for relaxation and ease.
